name: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B
attention_variant: hybrid: linear attention (Gated DeltaNet) with full attention every 4th layer (10 of 40)
notes: First Qwen generation to abandon all-full attention. Architecture config is now nested (text_config + vision_config) under Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration. layer_types over 40 layers: 30 linear_attention + 10 full_attention, full_attention_interval 4, linear_conv_kernel_dim 4, linear_num_value_heads 32. This is the Gated DeltaNet / gated-linear-attention pattern, and it is the single most serving-relevant change in the Qwen line. kv_cache_bytes_per_token = 10 full-attention layers x 2 kv_heads x head_dim 256 x 2 x 2 bytes = 10 x 2 x 256 x 2 x 2 = 20,480 B/token (20 KiB). The 30 linear-attention layers hold a fixed-size recurrent state instead of a growing cache, so KV becomes nearly length-independent. If all 40 layers cached like a normal GQA stack this model would need 40 x 2 x 256 x 2 x 2 = 81,920 B/token - 4x the actual figure. Compare with Qwen3-30B-A3B (the previous generation's small MoE): nearly identical KV per token (20 vs 96 KiB... note 20 KiB vs 96 KiB, a 4.8x reduction) at similar active size, and similar total params. MoE: 256 experts, 8 per token, PLUS a shared expert (shared_expert_intermediate_size 512) - the first Qwen MoE to add one, matching DeepSeek's convention. Vendor: 35B total / 3B activated; safetensors total 35.95B. hidden 2048, moe_intermediate_size 512, gqa_ratio 8 (16 heads / 2 kv heads), context 262144, rope_theta 1000000. Apache-2.0. Multimodal (vision_config present).
